name: Combustion Chemistry
summary: The thermochemistry and chain-reaction kinetics of burning, from flame structure and ignition to pollutants and rocket chambers.

topics.name: Combustion stoichiometry: equivalence ratio and air-fuel ratio
Thermochemistry of combustion and adiabatic flame temperature
Chain-branching kinetics and the H2-O2 explosion limits
Hydrocarbon oxidation mechanisms: low- and high-temperature chemistry
Ignition: autoignition, ignition delay and cool flames
Laminar premixed flames: flame speed and structure
Pollutant formation: NOx, CO, soot and particulates
Detailed and reduced kinetic mechanisms; sensitivity analysis
Combustion diagnostics: laser-induced fluorescence and absorption spectroscopy
Combustion in engines, gas turbines and rocket chambers
